extName.message: FullTube — Clean Video Window & Theater Mode

extDescription.message: Watch just the video: pop the player into a clean window or use YouTube theater mode (Alt+T). No downloads, no tracking.

actionTitle.message: Open clean player · YouTube: Alt+T theater mode

errTabNotAllowed.message: This tab does not allow the extension to access the player. Open a regular page and try again.

errPageInaccessible.message: Could not access this page. If the video is in a protected iframe, open it on its own page.

errNoPlayer.message: No visible HTML5 player was found on this page.

errPopupNotPrepared.message: The player window could not be prepared.

errOpenFailed.message: Could not open the player on this page.

popupNoPlayer.message: Could not detect an HTML5 player in this window. The page was left open.

popupAutoplayBlocked.message: The browser blocked autoplay. Use the native controls to start playback.

welcomeLead.message: Watch just the video, without the rest of the page.

welcomeStep1Text.message: On a page with a video, click the FullTube icon. The player opens in a clean 960×600 window.

welcomeStep2Text.message: On YouTube, press Alt+T for theater mode in the same tab. Esc to leave.

welcomeAccessTitle.message: Why does it ask for access to all sites?

welcomeAccessText.message: To prepare the clean window on any site you choose. Nothing is collected or sent: FullTube uses no cookies, does not extract streams and does not download videos.
